name: orbit-agentic-pair-programming-for-smalltalk
displayName: Orbit: Agentic Pair Programming for Smalltalk
description: A livecoding pair-programming harness for Smalltalk.

orbit.autoStart.description: Automatically start the Orbit web server when VS Code starts. When false (the default), Orbit only starts when the user clicks "Start Orbit" in the Orbit view. When true, Orbit starts on extension activation so browser tabs left open at the Orbit URL can reconnect after a restart.

orbit.mountWebdav.description: Add a workspace folder for each reachable Smalltalk WebDAV backend (orbit-webdav://<backend>/) when Orbit starts, and remove them when Orbit stops. Served by the in-process FileSystemProvider; no host-OS WebDAV client is required.

commands.title: Orbit: Add WebDAV Folder to Workspace

languageModelTools.name: orbit_runIsolatedSubagent
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Spawn a GitHub Copilot CLI subprocess to perform a task with access to the Orbit MCP backend (and the spawned process's own tools). The subprocess is its own tool-calling harness, so intermediate tool calls and their outputs do NOT appear in the VSCode chat activity UI; only the subagent's final text response is returned to the orchestrator. USE FOR: tasks where intermediate tool outputs (e.g. fetched method source code) must remain hidden from the VSCode UI. The subagent's final text WILL be visible — only intermediate work is isolated.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Runs a GitHub Copilot CLI subprocess with isolated tool calls; only the final response surfaces.

prompt.description: Detailed task description for the isolated subagent. Include all context the subagent needs; it does not share your conversation.

model.description: Optional Copilot CLI model name (e.g. 'gpt-5.4', 'claude-sonnet-4'). Omit to use the CLI default.
